title: Nuevo Laredo Brings Oaxaca to the Border: Free Guelaguetza Show Set for Sunday, Nov. 22
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo will host a free Guelaguetza Oaxaqueña performance on Sunday, Nov. 22, at 7 p.m. at the Teatro Principal of the Centro Cultural, with music, dance and traditional dress from Oaxaca's regions performed by local troupes.
content:
Nuevo Laredo will host a free Guelaguetza Oaxaqueña performance on Sunday, Nov. 22, at 7 p.m. at the Teatro Principal of the Centro Cultural de Nuevo Laredo, the municipal government announced Saturday.

The multidisciplinary show will bring music, dance and tradition from the state of Oaxaca to Nuevo Laredo families, with traditional dress and dances from Oaxaca's different regions performed by local municipal groups, children's troupes and invited academies, according to the announcement.

The performing groups are Grupo Municipal Mextli, Mextli Infantil, Grupo de Danza del Tecnológico, Grupo de Danza Casa de la Cultura Viveros, Grupo AIDIN, Ballet Folclórico de Nuevo Laredo and Grupo de Danza Telpochcalli.

Admission is free for children, young people and adults. The event is organized by the municipal government's Dirección de Arte y Cultura, which said the show aims to encourage family time together, open spaces for cultural exchange and support local artistic talent.

Source: Gobierno Municipal de Nuevo Laredo, via Nube Tamaulipas, Nov. 14, 2026.
